title: Use of OSI IS-IS for Routing in TCP/IP and Dual Environments
summary: Specifies an integrated routing protocol, based on OSI IS-IS, that can serve as an interior gateway protocol for TCP/IP, OSI, or mixed networks. This lets one routing protocol handle both kinds of traffic. It was developed by the IETF IS-IS working group.

eli5.summary: Delivery drivers need maps. This gives one map style that works for two different kinds of roads at the same time.
